user_story: As an authenticated user, I want to register and sign in so that I can securely use the system.
As an authenticated user, I want to upload an audio or video file so that the system can analyze it.
As an authenticated user, I want uploaded media to be processed asynchronously so the UI remains responsive.
As an authenticated user, I want the system to create a transcript so spoken content becomes readable.
As an authenticated user, I want the system to save analysis results so that I can review them later.
As an authenticated user, I want to view processed items in a dashboard.
As an authenticated user, I want a summary of the transcript so I can review content quickly.
As an authenticated user, I want named entity extraction so I can detect important references.
As an authenticated user, I want to manage an entity watchlist so alerts can be personalized.
As an authenticated user, I want alert matches to be highlighted when watched entities are found.
As an administrator, I want containerized deployment so the system is reproducible.
As a user, I want richer notifications for matches so I can react without opening the dashboard.
As a user, I want filtering and search on historical results.
As a developer, I want automated AI integration tests for production models.
As a user, I want anonymous access without sign-in.
